In addition, despite the dis- parities in composition, the energy results of the hcp_2, hcp_3, and ccp_1 structures (already experimentally veri- ﬁed) show a trend consistent with the experimental results. Moreover, an Ehull value close to 0 indicates a thermody- namically stable structure, and our results (Table 1), which show Ehull values below 30 meVatom-1 for all structures, imply potential synthesizability under speciﬁc experimen- tal conditions.
